Hi—sorry about this. We understand the situation is urgent, and we’ll help get this investigated.

To speed things up, can you reply with just the following details?
1) What exactly is failing? (e.g., login, specific page/feature, uploading, integrations, checkout, etc.)
2) Any error message text you see (or a screenshot).
3) When did it start, and are you seeing this for all users or just your account/team?
4) Are you using web or mobile? (and browser/device if web)
5) Your app version/build if you know it.

We’ve flagged this for immediate engineering review based on your report that the app is “broken again” and previously happened “last time.” If you can share the items above, we can correlate your report faster and work toward restoring normal operation.

Customer indicates prior occurrence: the issue happened "last time" as well.
Customer reports urgency pressure: "my boss is mad" and "I do not have time to explain this again."
Ticket is already classified as "outage" with "needs_human_review": true and "urgency": "critical".
